integrity: The analytic proof covers stated exact parameter domain; numerical checks only corroborate and do not substitute for proofs. Source papers are cited and none is reproduced.
scientific_limitations: Finite open uniform-hopping one-particle rhombic chain, uniform flux and exactly one upper-rim absorber; no uniform finite-time convergence, disorder, or multiparticle extension. An equivalent specialized result might exist elsewhere.
title: Flux- and position-sharp capture ranks for a finite rhombic quantum chain
